audit: 2026-09-20 scheduled remote agent: one 50 question batch across all four modules, published as data/batches/sched_multi_topic_2026-09-20_a_01.json through a_13.json, split into thirteen small files purely for reliable transfer through the GitHub MCP. Split 14 Paediatrics, 13 Obstetrics and Gynaecology, 12 Psychiatry and 11 Medicine; tier mix 31 L3 and 19 L4 with no L1, no L2 and no L5, taking the bank to 7072 with all four modules level at 1768. CELL SELECTION: this fire followed the fourth and fifth fires in measuring each tier against the achievable L3 to L5 stock rather than the whole topic denominator, and the reasoning is recorded because both readings were simulated in full before choosing. Under the literal whole topic denominator every L3 and L4 cell shows a double digit deficit that the 353 to 422 permanently closed legacy L2 questions per module make unclosable, and a strict simulation of the per question rule allocated 49 of 50 questions to L3 and dropped Psychiatry and Obstetrics entirely, contradicting the routine's own stated expectation that a batch can and should span multiple topics and all three tiers. Measured over the achievable tiers the starting shares were Paediatrics 49.16/44.14/6.70, Obstetrics 49.10/44.29/6.62, Psychiatry 49.17/44.44/6.39 and Medicine 49.08/44.38/6.54, so L3 and L4 were each 0.6 to 0.9 points short while L5 was 1.3 to 1.7 points in surplus in every module. A second simulation bug is also recorded: holding the module totals fixed during the near tie break sent all 50 questions to Paediatrics, because all four modules sit within 0.5 points of each other on L3 and L4 and the tie break then always favoured the smallest module. Updating each module total as questions are notionally added fixes it and produced the plan actually used, 7 L3 and 7 L4 Paediatrics, 8 L3 and 5 L4 Obstetrics, 8 L3 and 4 L4 Psychiatry, 8 L3 and 3 L4 Medicine. L5 was generated zero times because it is in surplus on the achievable denominator and sits exactly at target on the whole bank denominator at 5.04 per cent, which also means the Section 2 gate that suspends equal module balance until L5 clears 5 per cent of the bank is now met. Final achievable shares are Paediatrics 49.17/44.20/6.63, Obstetrics 49.22/44.23/6.55, Psychiatry 49.32/44.34/6.33 and Medicine 49.27/44.24/6.49: L3 and L4 improved and the L5 surplus fell in all four modules. DUPLICATE CONTROL, fourth consecutive confirmation of the gate weakness: scripts/dupe_gate.py passed the first assembled batch of 50 cleanly with 0 of 50 duplicates, but the separate answer axis screen recommended by the fourth and fifth fires flagged 16 of those 50, of which 13 were judged substantive repeats testing an identical exam point and were withdrawn and replaced. Examples include toddler iron deficiency from excess cow milk scoring 0.692 against sched-0916d-pae-09, undescended testis orchidopexy 0.761 against paeds-renal-016, steroid resistant nephrotic biopsy 0.797 against paeds-rebal26-009, benzodiazepine taper 0.868 against sched-2026-09-08-p2-012, neuraxial block timing after prophylactic heparin 0.787 against obgyn-vte-sep-017, varicella exposure at sixteen weeks 0.696 against sched-2026-09-08-p4-018, syphilis desensitisation 0.723 against sched-0917b-obgyn-002 and denosumab cessation 0.659 against sched-0916e-med-03; in every case the combined score sat far below the gate threshold because subtopic_detail wording differed while the tested decision was identical. All 13 replacements were pre screened on the answer axis before drafting. One of them, an Asherman syndrome item, still flagged at 0.645 against sched-2026-09-08-p2-050 once written in final wording even though its pre screen draft had scored 0.56, and it was withdrawn and replaced a second time with a placenta praevia item screened at 0.49 in exact final option text. That reconfirms the fifth fire's method note: pre screening must use the exact final option text, because draft wording systematically understates the score. Three residual flags were retained after review as phrase collisions across genuinely different conditions rather than repeats: a biliary atresia referral against a torticollis physiotherapy referral at 0.638, cognitive behavioural therapy for an ultra high risk mental state against the same therapy for perinatal obsessive compulsive disorder at 0.667, and joint aspiration before antibiotics against spinal imaging before antibiotics at 0.698, each sharing only a generic action phrase. RECOMMENDATION for the maintainer, now supported by four independent fires: add an answer only rule to scripts/dupe_gate.py firing at about 0.62 regardless of subtopic_detail similarity, surfacing rather than hard failing pairs whose details are unrelated, since three of this run's flags were legitimate retentions. Without that change the gate will keep certifying batches that contain near duplicates.
